helper_text: Sent to clients on their birthday.
name: birthday_message
sms: Happy Birthday {client}, Wishing you a day filled with laughter, love, and unforgettable moments. As a valued client, we want you to know just how much we appreciate your trust in us. Enjoy your special day to the fullest and may this year bring you even more success and happiness. Cheers to another amazing year ahead.

helper_text: Sent when a new plot is attached to a client profile.
name: onboarding_sms
sms:
CONGRATULATIONS {client}!
We have successfully added your new plot, {plot}, to your profile. Thank you for trusting us with this important step in your investment journey. Need help or have questions? Call us anytime at {branch_tel}. We would greatly appreciate it if you could take a moment to rate us on Google at  https://shorturl.at/egkT2. Your feedback is important to us as we strive to improve our service.
For complains and compliments, email us at feedback@fanaka.co.ke.

helper_text: Reminder for clients to pay for their plot.
name: payment_reminder_sms
sms:
Dear {client}, so far you have paid Ksh. {paid} for your plot with us. Your total balance is Ksh. {balance}, your monthly installment is Ksh. {monthly_installment} due on {due_date} Kindly pay to avoid any penalties.
For complains and compliments, email us at feedback@fanaka.co.ke.

helper_text: Sent when a payment is approved by the supervisor.
name: payment_notification_sms
sms:
Dear {client}, Thank you for your payment of Ksh. {amount}, so far you have paid  {paid} for your plot. Your total balance is {balance}. We appreciate your promptness.
For complains and compliments, email us at feedback@fanaka.co.ke.

helper_text: Sent when a payment is removed from the client profile.
name: payment_removed_sms
sms:
Hello {client},
Your previous payment of {removed_amount} has been reversed, {removal_reason} . Your current balance is {balance}. For any queries, feel free to call us.
For complains and compliments, email us at feedback@fanaka.co.ke.

helper_text: Sent when a payment is overdue.
name: payment_overdue_sms

helper_text: Sent when a plot is fully paid; requests completion document.
name: payment_completed_sms
sms:
CONGRATULATIONS, {client}! 
You have successfully completed the purchase of {plot}, and now have full possession of your plot. To finalize the documentation, kindly share a copy of your ID, KRA PIN, and a passport photo. Once again, congratulations on this major milestone!

name: referral_message
sms: Dear {client}, We have a New incentive for our clients who refer clients to us. Call {agent} on {tel} for more details. Thank you for Investing with us.

helper_text: Sent when a penalty is charged on a sale.
name: penalty_charge_sms

helper_text: Reminder when a plot is not paid for at release 3 days.
name: reservation_removal_reminder

helper_text: Sent when a reservation is released due to lack of funds.
name: reservation_removed
site_visit_reminder
sms:
Dear {client}, We have booked you for a Site Visit on {date} at {time}. Your pick up point is  {pick_location}. Call {agent} on {tel} for more details.
For complains and compliments, email us at feedback@fanaka.co.ke.

helper_text: Sent when client missed scheduled site visit.
name: site_visit_absentee
sms:
Dear {client}, You can now be picked up for a Site Visit any day from Monday to Sunday at a place of your convenience. Call {agent} on {tel} for more details. 
For complains and compliments, email us at feedback@fanaka.co.ke.

helper_text: Sent after a completed site visit.
name: site_visit_thankyou_note
